visualCharacteristics.layout: 3 equal bordered tiles in a row beside the intro tile; 295x160 media area on top, then title, large stat value, stat label and description

animations.dataAttributes: role=img aria-label="Each box represents one million packages; 62 million packages insured in 2025"; g._groundPlate_1rjsv_17[data-ground]; text classes _boxMetricValue_1rjsv_34 ('1M') and _boxMetricLabel_1rjsv_35 ('Packages')
animations.depicts: Isometric cardboard box labelled '1M Packages' with an '=' legend
animations.howItAnimates: Static: no SMIL, CSS keyframes, WAAPI or DOM mutation at rest, on scroll or on hover. Generated by JS at runtime

animations.elementType: canvas, WebGL2, three.js r186 (canvas data-engine="three.js r186")
animations.dataAttributes: wrapper: role=img aria-label="Freight journey: a truck, a container ship and a cargo plane" data-freight-journey data-active=false|true data-reduced=false data-renderer=webgl; canvas host: data-vehicle=truck|ship|plane data-phase=cruise|exit data-wheels=4 data-wheel-turn data-finish=color data-clock (ms)
animations.externalAssets: none: no glTF/GLB, texture, JSON or Lottie files were requested; the geometry is procedural
animations.depicts: Isometric 3D teal freight truck on a ground plate; the cycle continues to a container ship and then a cargo plane
animations.howItAnimates: Hover/activation-triggered loop: on tile hover data-active becomes true, the wheels turn, the truck drives off (cruise to exit) and the ship, then the plane, cruise in, timed by data-clock. Still frame at rest; honours reduced motion (data-reduced)
animations.fallback: hidden inline SVG line drawing div._fallback_le6y0_9 (160x151)

animations.dataAttributes: wrapper: role=img aria-label="Laptop illustrating a claim being submitted, followed by a shield and check confirming receipt, not payment." data-claims-laptop=color data-renderer=webgl; canvas host: data-claims-phase=rest|uploading|... data-claims-progress (0-1) data-claims-cycle data-enter-key-press data-shield-turn data-claims-burst data-confetti-count
animations.depicts: Isometric 3D dark laptop with a teal screen on a ground plate
animations.howItAnimates: Hover/activation-triggered sequence: the Enter key presses, an upload progress bar fills (phase uploading), a shield with a check spins in (shieldTurn up to 2 pi) with a confetti burst, then it returns to rest

contentPattern.perCard: cell 1 = media: a poster image (the static or fallback SVG) followed by an animation key paragraph (none | freight-journey | claims-laptop) that the block JS maps to a three.js renderer; cell 2 = title as a paragraph (not a heading), stat value in <strong> (kept out of headings), stat label, description
cards: Trusted insurance provider | 62M | packages insured in 2025* | As a trusted insurance provider, UPS Capital Insurance Agency, Inc. is backed by AA-rated insurance capacity...
Multi-carrier, multi-modal | $85B | global insured value in 2025* | Insure eligible shipments across all parcel, ocean, and freight carriers...
Simpler insurance claims | $132M | in claims paid in 2025* | File insurance claims online across carriers...
contentPattern.runtime: Lazy-load three.js (a self-hosted ES module in /scripts/ or the block folder) only when a card with an animation key enters the viewport; start the loop on tile hover/focus (on touch devices, when it enters the viewport); show the poster when WebGL is unavailable or prefers-reduced-motion is set
rows: poster image + animation key (none | freight-journey | claims-laptop)

usage: Row of stat tiles: media area (poster image, optionally replaced by a three.js animation), title, large stat value, stat label and description.
reuseGuidance: Cell 1 = poster image + an animation key paragraph: none, freight-journey or claims-laptop. Cell 2 = title, **stat value** (bold-only paragraph), stat label, description. Unknown keys fall back to the poster.
